Bone ran very well to win the 100 yards and should be heard of again this season.
Undoubtedly in Bone (who is Surrey Junior Champion), Dyke, Crilly and Fleming we have four sprinters who may well be winning the Senior A.A.A. title for us in a few years time.

In the 4 x 100 yards we had to turn out two half-milers, in Kench and Frank Webb, our only two sprinters being Basford and Bone. Croydon won this event from Mitcham and incidentally this was Mitcham's only defeat of the evening.
Bone ran very well to get up off 4 yards to win in 12½ secs.

Eddie Pack ran the 440 yards stage and did well in handing over third behind Whittingham and Pallett. Stroud and Bone both did their bit in keeping this position; and Tommy went off about 30 yards behind the leaders, who were A.
We (the Belgrave Harriers) would also like to see some of the older members back in training, such as Messrs. Bone, Mewes, Kealey and Co. The Club has many promising juniors also.
A Belgrave team of Dyke, Bone and Mewes was entered. Evidently it was a regular race as previous times of 10.8 etc are given and winners had been Poly and Blackheath.
